title: Automated Client Onboarding Orchestration
business: Boutique legal consultancy firms managing high-volume client intake via email.
problem: Legal associates lose significant billable hours manually cross-referencing incoming client inquiry threads with calendar availability and drafting personalized engagement responses.
solution: By integrating the Superhuman Mail connector with Claude, the firm can automate the retrieval of email threads and availability, allowing the AI to draft tailored responses and schedule initial consultations directly within the chat interface.
steps: Authenticate the Superhuman Mail connector within the Claude interface using the provided MCP endpoint.
Utilize query_email_and_calendar to identify new client inquiry threads and extract relevant contact details.
Invoke get_availability to cross-reference the associate's calendar with the client's requested timeframe.
Generate a draft engagement email using create_or_update_draft, incorporating the associate's preferred tone and the confirmed meeting slot.
Review the generated draft within Claude and execute send_draft to finalize the communication.
outcome: Associates achieve a more consistent client intake experience with reduced administrative friction, allowing them to focus on substantive legal work rather than email management.
limitation: The connector relies on the AI's interpretation of email context; complex threads with multiple stakeholders may lead to misidentified meeting times. Users must verify the draft content against the original thread before sending, as the AI may occasionally misattribute availability constraints.

questions.question: In Automated Client Onboarding Orchestration, what is the primary benefit of using the Superhuman Mail connector?

It provides real-time financial metrics on the profitability of each client inquiry.

The connector is incompatible with Gmail and Outlook accounts.
